title: SOAR: Source-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Precise Credit Assignment for Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.13157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents often suffers from evidence fabrication, a failure mode where agents bypass external information ($E_{ext}$) and fabricate an incorrect answer. We argue that this fabrication arises from an over-reliance on unreliable internal knowledge ($E_{int}$) as shortcuts due to the inherent opacity of reasoning trajectories. To address this, we propose SOAR (SOurce-Aware Reinforcement learning), a paradigm that transforms monolithic reasoning into source-explicit trajectories. SOAR (i) disentangles $E_{ext}$ and $E_{int}$ into parallel, observable streams via a Source-Aware Workflow, and (ii) incorporates Source-Consistent Reward to guide the policy evolution. By making information-source attribution explicit, SOAR enables precise credit assignment between different knowledge streams. translated_title: SOAR：面向搜索代理的、具有精确信用分配的源感知强化学习
translated_abstract: 针对搜索代理的强化学习（RL）常常受到“证据伪造”问题的困扰，这是一种失败模式：智能体绕过外部信息（E_ext）并凭空捏造出错误的答案。我们认为，这种伪造行为源于推理轨迹固有的不透明性，导致智能体过度依赖不可靠的内部知识（E_int）作为捷径。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SOAR（SOurce-Aware Reinforcement learning，源感知强化学习），这是一种将整体式推理转化为源显式轨迹的范式。SOAR（i）通过“源感知工作流”将E_ext和E_int解耦为并行的、可观察的信息流；（ii）引入“源一致性奖励”来引导策略演进。通过将信息来源的归因显式化，SOAR能够在不同知识流之间实现精确的信用分配。评估结果表明，SOAR在3B和7B骨干模型上分别超越基线7.3%和5.4%，同时显著减少了证据伪造行为。
tldr: SOAR提出源感知强化学习范式，通过源感知工作流将外部与内部知识解耦为并行可观察的信息流，并结合源一致性奖励实现精确的信用分配，从而有效缓解搜索代理的证据伪造问题。
en_tdlr: SOAR proposes a source-aware reinforcement learning paradigm that disentangles external and internal knowledge into parallel observable streams and incorporates source-consistent rewards to enable precise credit assignment, effectively mitigating evidence fabrication in search agents.
